This free tool makes long AI videos, on a cheap graphics card.
It's called FramePack, and it's open source.
Most video AI needs huge, expensive GPUs. FramePack runs on just six gigabytes of VRAM.
And here's the trick, a one minute video uses the same memory as a one second one.
You can generate up to two minutes, at thirty frames per second.
Made by the creator of ControlNet, and it's totally free.
